newsitem.title: USA: American Freightways sets fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: American Freightways sets fuel surcharge.

text.p: American Freightways Corp said it would add a diesel fuel surcharge to its freight rates effective September 16.
The company said in a statement late on Wednesday the surcharge was in response to rising fuel costs.
The surcharge will be determined from the Department of Energy's National Diesel Fuel Index and updated weekly. At Wednesday's index the surcharge would be one percent.

The company said it absorbed higher diesel fuel costs during the first half of the year resulting in lower earnings of $0.05 per share. Costs peaked in April and returned to more normal levels, only to start inflating again during August.

The company said with current crude oil inventories at low levels, with winter fuel oil requirements approaching, and with the current political volatility in the Middle East it did not appear likely that diesel fuel costs would soon return to normal levels.
It also said it did not expect the fuel surcharge to totally compensate for the increase in fuel costs going forward.
